title: A Coloring Book for Children: Fun Activities, Games, and Illustrations to Teach Essential Life Skills: Coloring Book, Children, Activities, Life Skills
description:
A children’s coloring and activity book designed to teach good habits and essential life skills through games, coloring, tracing, and cartoon-animal illustrations. The listing describes a split-page format: a colored example on the left and a black-and-white outline for the child to color on the right.

Topics include brushing teeth, washing hands, covering sneezes, drinking water, dressing neatly, combing hair, getting enough sleep, sharing toys, saying please and thank you, tidying up, and wearing a helmet while riding a bike.
